NDP NS/NA, ICMPv6 echo<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;hands it to eth_mgmt ... UDP port 28536<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;drops it ............... everything else<br><br>from SGMII (host) -- forwarded to RGMII, never examined.<br>responses are injected toward RGMII only: management<br>rides the copper side." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Courier New;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;strokeWidth=1;fillColor=none;fontColor=#F5B944;strokeColor=#F5B944;arcSize=3;fontSize=11;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="650" width="620" height="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
what happens to a frame
from RGMII (copper) -- always forwarded to SGMII, and a copy
goes to the endpoint, which does one of:
answers it itself ..... NDP NS/NA, ICMPv6 echo
hands it to eth_mgmt ... UDP port 28536
drops it ............... everything else
from SGMII (host) -- forwarded to RGMII, never examined.
responses are injected toward RGMII only: management
rides the copper side.
